messages.name: Jessica Chen
messages.message: Hi Muhammad, I came across your Jarvis Voice Assistant repo. Your architecture for system automation is highly impressive. Would you be open to a contract position at Tesla?

messages.name: Haris Ahmed
messages.message: Excited to see a Developer with high AI competency from Karachi. I'd love to collaborate on a Django-based LLM agent project. Let's schedule a call!

chatLogs.reply: Muhammad Mawiya's tagline is: 'If it can be automated, I will automate it.'
He is currently pursuing his BS in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Karachi (UBIT), starting from 2025.
